deploy-bot: Canary rollout detected elevated 5xx rate from wave-47 in us-east-1 — healthcheck failures above abort threshold
incidents-bot: Pager -> @mike_oncall (severity: P2). See alert: https://grafana/redwood/alert/6231
mike_oncall: Taking pager. Seeing a sharp 502/503 spike from inference-gateway -> quantized-model pods. Canary traffic ~5% but error rate ~25% for last 2m.
sara_eng: Oncall dev here, I kicked the canary this morning (llm-new-quant) — starting a quick rollback/flag cutover now. Flipping feature flag `llm-new-quant` to `off` and draining canary.
kevin_sre: Logs show KV cache evictions and OOM-kinda traces on quantized runtime around 12:01:15Z. Sample log: ```[2026-03-17T12:01:12Z] inference: worker-23 ERR 502 upstream_reset kvcache_count=0 mem_free=120Mi```
mike_oncall: Good plan. Sara, confirm when flag is flipped and when canary instance set is drained. Also start traffic fallback to model-v1.
sara_eng: Flag flipped -> off at ~12:02:08Z. Triggering drain on wave-47 via rollout API: `rdwctl rollout abort --wave wave-47`.
incidents-bot: Rollout abort executed by sara_eng at 12:02:10Z. Autobalance routing switching to model-v1 for affected routes.
kevin_sre: I see error-rate falling in the last 30s. 5xx across region reduced from 24% -> 4% (1m window). Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/overview/rollouts?view=wave-47
tom_support: We have a small set of customers (3) that opened support tickets referencing increased latency + 502s during 11:59–12:03Z. Filing customer-impact note.
mike_oncall: Triage notes: cause likely regression in quantized runtime under realistic prefix lengths + small mem leak under load. Immediate mitigation: feature flag off + abort. Next: collect traces, heap profiles, and KV cache dump from affected pods.
sara_eng: Grabbing dumps now. Will push upload link once available. Starting canary re-run with safety params disabled (lower batch size) once we have root cause.
kevin_sre: Putting temporary alert mute for wave-47 related alerts to avoid noisy pagers. Will keep P2 watch.
mike_oncall: Handoff: I'll keep this incident open for 1h for follow-up. Assigning to sara_eng for root cause, kevin_sre for infra postmortem, and tom_support to coordinate customer comms.
sara_eng: Upload: https://s3.redwood/reports/wave-47-dumps.tar.gz (profiling + logs).
mike_oncall: Final status: customer impact limited (few customers, short window), rollback successful, monitoring shows steady state. Closing active pager but leaving incident thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
